questions.q: What was Chapter 2's actual job, across all 17 lessons?
options: Teach Power BI report design from scratch
Replace the need for the Fabric & Real-Time Analytics course entirely
Teach entirely new Fabric technology not covered anywhere else in the track
Drill material already taught in earlier courses, from the specific angle the DP-700 exam asks about it
questions.explain: Every lesson in this chapter pointed back to material from the System Design chapter, the Fabric course, or the Databricks course — nothing here was new technology.

questions.q: How many official DP-700 domains are there, and roughly how are they weighted?
options: Two domains, split 50/50
One domain covering the entire exam
Five domains, one worth 60% of the exam
Three domains, each roughly 30-35% — a near-even split
questions.explain: Lesson 27 established the three near-even domains that every later lesson in this chapter was organized around.

questions.q: What recurring pattern showed up across all six practice-question sets (Lessons 31-36)?
options: DP-700 rewards the narrowest correct control or tool over a broader one that would also technically work
Only Domain 1 was covered across all six sets
Security questions never appeared in any practice set
Every question had exactly one plausible answer with no wrong options
questions.explain: From OneLake/Lakehouse access down to monitoring versus deployment tooling, the same narrowest-control pattern was the deciding factor in nearly every worked question.

questions.q: What did Lesson 37 add on top of the six practice-question sets?
options: A seventh practice-question set
The official Microsoft exam registration process
Five named trap patterns that explain why the wrong answers in those sets were wrong
A brand-new Fabric feature not covered elsewhere
questions.explain: Lesson 37 generalized the wrong-answer patterns — lookalike items, overcomplication, absolute wording, buried qualifiers, over-broad controls — seen throughout Lessons 31-36.

questions.q: What do Lessons 40 and 41 add up to, together?
options: A live proctored exam booking
A single 5-question quiz
An 18-question mixed-domain mock exam split into two timed sittings
A repeat of Lesson 27's domain overview
questions.explain: Nine questions per lesson, mixed across all three domains, meant to be taken under the time budget from Lesson 39 and scored together.

questions.q: What comes right after Chapter 2 in this course?
options: Chapter 3, "AI for Data Engineers (Bonus)", starting with Copilot in Fabric
The end of the entire 4-course Data Engineering track
A second certification exam chapter for a different certification
A repeat of Chapter 1's system design material
questions.explain: Chapter 2 is now complete; Chapter 3 shifts away from exam prep and back to hands-on AI-assisted data engineering material.
